questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.**

Dubai is like an oasis ________ the middle of a desert.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'in'** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• A**preposition**is a word or group of words used before a noun, pronoun, or phrase to show direction, time, place, location, or to introduce an object.

 
 
• ​**Example: **"at", "in", "on", "upon" etc.​
 
 
 
• ​The preposition**'in'**is used to indicate location, to specify day, month, or year, to indicate color, shape, or size.
 
 
• ​Here in this sentence**'in'**is used to indicate location.*example:__ "__Water is **in **the container"​__*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, We will use**'in'**to fill in the blank.

 

**The correct sentence will be:***​"__Dubai is like an oasis__*__***in***__*__the middle of a desert__".*

__
 
• Hence,** option 3**is the correct answer.​​​

​

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• **Preposition **दिशा, समय, स्थान, स्थान, या किसी वस्तु का परिचय देने के लिए **'noun', pronoun, or 'phrase'** से पहले इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला शब्द या शब्दों का समूह है।

 
 
• **उदाहरण:** "at", "in", "on", "upon" etc.
 
 
 
• The preposition'in' रंग, आकार या आकार को इंगित करने के लिए, स्थान को इंगित करने के लिए **day, month or year **निर्दिष्ट करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।
 
 
• यहाँ इस वाक्य में **'in'**स्थान को इंगित करने के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है। उदाहरण:__

 __"Water is in the container"​__
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, We will use'in'to fill in the blank.

​इसलिए सही वाक्य होगा: *​"__Dubai is like an oasis __*__*in *__*__the middle of a desert__".*

 
• अत:** विकल्प 3** सही उत्तर है।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it select 'No substitution required'.

Thousands of people __gathered between__ the stadium to attend the rally.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"****gathered at".**

***__Key Points__** 

__
 
• A preposition is a word or group of words used before a noun, pronoun, or noun phrase to show direction, time, place, or relation to an object.

 
 
• Example: "to", "with", "on", "in" etc.
 
 
 
• ​The preposition 'at' is used to express the location or arrival in a particular place or position.
 
 
• Example: *They live at the pink leaf house. *__ 
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the preposition 'at' will be used here, So** 'gathered at'** is the correct answer.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** Let's discuss the remaining prepositions - 

__
 
• On to - To a position on something.

 
 
• Example: The cat jumped **onto **the sofa.__*
 
 
 
• Over - Straight above something, But not touching it.
 __
 
• Example: *We watched the plane flyer over.*__
 
 

__*​ * [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• Preposition किसी संज्ञा, सर्वनाम या संज्ञा वाक्यांश से पहले किसी वस्तु की दिशा, समय, स्थान या संबंध दिखाने के लिए इस्तेमाल किया जाने वाला शब्द या शब्दों का समूह है I

 
 
• **उदाहरण: **"to", "with", "on", "in" etc.
 
 
 
• ​The preposition 'at' ​किसी विशेष स्थान या स्थिति में स्थान या आगमन को व्यक्त करने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है I
 
 
• उदाहरण: *They live at the pink leaf house.*__
 
 
 
• __*​*__इसलिए, the preposition 'at' यहां इस्तेमाल किया जाएगा, अत: 'gathered at' सही उत्तर है।

questions.question:
Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.

Much villagers attended the feast hosted by the village panchayat.
questions.solution:
The error is in 'Much villagers' 

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect and has an error of **determiners**.
 
• Here** 'Many villagers'** should be used instead of **'Much villagers'**
 
• **'Much' **is uncountable.__
 __
 
• **Example:** There is too **much** food at home for us. *{ here we cannot count food }
 
 
 
• **'Many' **is countable.__
 __
 
• ​__**Example: ***There are **many **girls in the classroom.*{ here we can count girls }​
 
 

**The correct sentence will be:** ***'****__**Many'** villagers attended the fest hosted by the village panchayat.__* 

__
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.

 

* **Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है और इसमें 'determiners ' की ​ त्रुटि है I
 
• यहां 'Much villagers' के बजाय 'Many villagers' इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए I
 
• 'Much' अगणनीय है।
 
 
• **उदाहरण: **There is too much food at home for us. *{ यहाँ हम भोजन की गिनती नहीं कर सकते }
 
 
 
• 'Many' गणनीय है I
 
 
• उदाहरण: *There are many girls in the classroom.*{ यहाँ हम लड़कियों की गिनती कर सकते हैं }
 
 

**सही वाक्य होगा: ***'**Many' villagers attended the fest hosted by the village panchayat.__* 

__
 
• अत: विकल्प 3 सही उत्तर है।

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__** 

In the given sentence, the word "**hosted**" is functioning as a past participle, which acts as an adjective modifying the noun "**fest**." In this case, there is no need to include "**was/were**" before "hosted" because the sentence is in the active voice and the verb "**hosted**" is describing the fest.

If we were to rephrase the sentence using the passive voice, we could say: "*The fest, which was hosted by the village panchayat, was attended by many villagers."*

In this revised sentence, "**was hosted**" is used to indicate the passive voice, and the verb "**attended**" is in the past tense to match the verb tense of "**was hosted."**

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The priest's sermon had a calming ________ on everybody.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**effect**' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'effect'.
 
• **'Effect' **means *a particular impression, or look someone wants to create and it is a noun.*
 
• In this sentence, the ***priest* **wants to create** an *impression or look.***
 
• ***Also, in this sentence, 'calming' is an adjective which is used in an attributive way i.e. 'a/an/the + adjective + noun.'***
 
• According to the above point **'effect'** is the correct option.

**The correct sentence is: ***The priest's sermon had a calming **effect **on everybody.*__

__
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

*​*__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• दिए गए रिक्त स्थान के लिए सबसे उपयुक्त शब्द 'effect' है I
 
• 'Effect' *का अर्थ है एक विशेष प्रभा है।*
 
• इस वाक्य में, पुजारी एक **छाप **या प्रभा बनाना चाहता है और यह एक संज्ञा है।
 
• साथ ही, इस वाक्य में, 'calming' एक विशेषण है जिसका प्रयोग गुणकारी तरीके से किया जाता है अर्थात 'a/an/the + विशेषण (adjective) + संज्ञा (noun)'।
 
• उपरोक्त बिंदु के अनुसार 'effect' सही विकल्प है।

**सही वाक्य है: ** *The priest's sermon had a calming effect on everybody.*__

__
 
• अत: विकल्प 2 सही उत्तर है।

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it. select 'No substitution required'.

The company has __the number of__ festival offers coming up soon.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'a number of'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Here the error is of **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• **'The number of'** rule **{** **the number of + plural noun + singular verb }**
 
• **'A number of' ** rule { **a number of + plural noun + plural verb }**
 
• According to the above point, **a number of **is used instead of **the number of.**

**​The correct sentence will be: ***The company has a*____* number of__*__* festival offers coming up soon.*__

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• यहाँ subject-verb agreement की त्रुटि है I
 
• 'The number of' का नियम { the number of + plural noun + singular verb }
 
• **'A number of'** का नियम { a number of + plural noun + plural verb }
 
• उपरोक्त बिंदु के अनुसार, the number of के बजाय a number of का प्रयोग किया जाता है I

**सही वाक्य होगा: ***The company has a*____* number of__*__* festival offers coming up soon.*__

अत: सही उत्तर विकल्प 2 है।
